description: This file defines a Java class MacroCallParameterStringValueEndsWithMatcher, which is a custom matcher used for testing string suffixes in the context of the OFBiz project's widget rendering macro package.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueEndsWithMatcher
classes.description: A custom Hamcrest matcher for verifying if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueEndsWithMatcher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the matcher with the suffix string.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks whether the given object is a string that ends with the specified suffix.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Describes the matcher condition, i.e., that a string ends with the specified suffix.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes the mismatch when the actual value does not meet the condition.
